files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] with name flair-backend and entry-point main.jac; a headless service slice with no npm or extra dependency tables (byllm ships with jaclang as jaclang.byllm).

Plain obj declarations (no nodes, no imports), each field with a default. obj DeterministicSignal has lane_retention_or_conversion:str="", category:str="", severity:str="medium", confidence:float=0.7, page_url:str="", issue_location:str="", evidence_ref:str="", evidence:str="", proof:str="", why_it_matters:str="", research_basis:str="", recommendation:str="", fix_guidance:str="", exact_ui_or_copy_tip:str="", primary_metric:str="", guardrail_metric:str="", estimated_effort:str="medium", expected_impact:str="medium". obj LlmFindingDraft has category:str="", lane_retention_or_conversion:str="", severity:str="medium", confidence:float=0.7, then the same string fields as DeterministicSignal from page_url through expected_impact with the same defaults, plus legal_safe:bool=True. obj LlmAuditBundle has score:int=60, the ten int category scores onboarding_activation, habit_loop_strength, reward_design_feedback, social_retention_mechanics, attention_capture_session_depth, personalization_adaptation, friction_reduction, progression_investment, reentry_notification_systems, trust_emotional_safety each default 5, strengths, weaknesses, retention_risks, highest_leverage_improvements as list[str] default [], dark_pattern_risk_score:int=0, dark_pattern_risk_reasons:list[str]=[], findings:list[LlmFindingDraft]=[]. Every obj and field carries a short sem description of its meaning for the LLM.

signatures.DeterministicSignal: obj DeterministicSignal { has lane_retention_or_conversion: str = ""; has category: str = ""; has severity: str = "medium"; has confidence: float = 0.7; has page_url: str = ""; ... has estimated_effort: str = "medium"; has expected_impact: str = "medium"; }
signatures.LlmFindingDraft: obj LlmFindingDraft { has category: str = ""; has lane_retention_or_conversion: str = ""; has severity: str = "medium"; has confidence: float = 0.7; ... has legal_safe: bool = True; }
signatures.LlmAuditBundle: obj LlmAuditBundle { has score: int = 60; has onboarding_activation: int = 5; ... has trust_emotional_safety: int = 5; has strengths: list[str] = []; has weaknesses: list[str] = []; has retention_risks: list[str] = []; has highest_leverage_improvements: list[str] = []; has dark_pattern_risk_score: int = 0; has dark_pattern_risk_reasons: list[str] = []; has findings: list[LlmFindingDraft] = []; }

files.purpose: Import Model from jaclang.byllm.lib and DeterministicSignal, LlmAuditBundle, LlmFindingDraft from services/models.jac. Declare glob llm: Model = Model(model_name="gpt-4o"). Declare the body-less function evaluate_retention_recommendations(target_url, evidence_pack, deterministic_signals: list[DeterministicSignal]) -> str by llm(max_tokens=3600), with the function sem and the three parameter sems exactly as given in signatures. The function returns raw JSON text; it never parses anything itself.

Import traceback and json; import DeterministicSignal, LlmFindingDraft, LlmAuditBundle from services/models.jac and evaluate_retention_recommendations from services/llm.jac. bounded_score clamps an int to 0..100; bounded_ten clamps to 0..10; blended_score(a,b) = bounded_score((bounded_score(a) + bounded_score(b)) // 2). rubric_overall(bundle): weighted float sum of bounded_ten of each category times its weight: onboarding_activation 1.0, habit_loop_strength 1.2, reward_design_feedback 1.1, social_retention_mechanics 1.0, attention_capture_session_depth 1.1, personalization_adaptation 1.2, friction_reduction 1.1, progression_investment 1.2, reentry_notification_systems 1.0, trust_emotional_safety 0.9; return bounded_score(int((weighted / 10.8) * 10.0)). draft_from_signal(signal) copies the 18 shared fields (lane_retention_or_conversion, category, severity, confidence, page_url, issue_location, evidence_ref, evidence, proof, why_it_matters, research_basis, recommendation, fix_guidance, exact_ui_or_copy_tip, primary_metric, guardrail_metric, estimated_effort, expected_impact) into an LlmFindingDraft with legal_safe=True. fallback_bundle(lane, signals, score): findings = draft_from_signal of every signal whose lane_retention_or_conversion == lane, in input order; if none, one baseline LlmFindingDraft with category "baseline opportunity", the given lane, severity "medium", confidence 0.55, page_url "", estimated_effort "low", expected_impact "medium", primary_metric lane + " score", guardrail_metric "support tickets and complaint rate", legal_safe True and short cautious explanatory text in the remaining fields. category_score is 5, but 3 when score < 40 and 7 when score > 75; all ten categories get category_score; bundle score = score unchanged; strengths []; weaknesses, retention_risks and highest_leverage_improvements each exactly one explanatory sentence (weaknesses says the LLM rubric evaluation was unavailable so deterministic crawler signals were used); dark_pattern_risk_score 0; dark_pattern_risk_reasons []. llm_json_payload(text): strip; drop a leading ```json (else a leading ```) and a trailing ```, stripping again; then if a '{' exists and the last '}' is at or after it, return the substring from the first '{' through the last '}' inclusive, else the cleaned text. json_str(data,key,fallback) returns str(data[key]) unless that is "None" or access fails (then fallback); json_int/json_float/json_bool cast data[key] with int/float/bool, fallback on any exception; json_string_list returns [str(item) for item in data[key]], returning the items collected so far on exception. bounded_confidence clamps a float to 0.0..1.0. parse_llm_findings(data) builds one LlmFindingDraft per item of data["findings"]: lane_retention_or_conversion always "retention"; defaults category "retention loop", severity "medium", confidence bounded_confidence(json_float(item,"confidence",0.7)), primary_metric "repeat sessions", guardrail_metric "complaints and opt-outs", estimated_effort "medium", expected_impact "medium", legal_safe json_bool default True, every other string field default ""; on any exception it returns the findings built so far. parse_llm_bundle(result, signals, score): data = json.loads(llm_json_payload(result)); if parse_llm_findings(data) is empty return fallback_bundle("retention", signals, score); otherwise return an LlmAuditBundle with score = bounded_score(json_int(data,"score",score)), each category bounded_ten(json_int(data,<name>,5)), the five list fields via json_string_list, dark_pattern_risk_score bounded_ten(json_int(data,"dark_pattern_risk_score",0)) and the parsed findings. json.loads errors propagate to the caller. safe_retention_bundle(target_url, evidence_pack, signals, score) prints [LLM RUBRIC] progress lines, then inside try calls evaluate_retention_recommendations(target_url, evidence_pack, signals) and returns parse_llm_bundle(result, signals, score); on any exception it prints the error and traceback and returns fallback_bundle("retention", signals, score).

signatures.blended_score: def blended_score(llm_score: int, deterministic_score: int) -> int
signatures.fallback_bundle: def fallback_bundle(lane: str, signals: list[DeterministicSignal], score: int) -> LlmAuditBundle
signatures.json_str: def json_str(data: any, key: str, fallback_value: str) -> str
signatures.json_int: def json_int(data: any, key: str, fallback_value: int) -> int
signatures.json_float: def json_float(data: any, key: str, fallback_value: float) -> float
signatures.json_bool: def json_bool(data: any, key: str, fallback_value: bool) -> bool
signatures.json_string_list: def json_string_list(data: any, key: str) -> list[str]
signatures.parse_llm_bundle: def parse_llm_bundle(result: str, signals: list[DeterministicSignal], score: int) -> LlmAuditBundle
signatures.safe_retention_bundle: def safe_retention_bundle(target_url: str, evidence_pack: str, signals: list[DeterministicSignal], score: int) -> LlmAuditBundle

files.purpose: Thin entry module holding only one import: safe_retention_bundle, parse_llm_bundle, fallback_bundle, rubric_overall and blended_score from services/audits.jac. No declarations of its own.

verify.flow: signals + evidence -> evaluate_retention_recommendations (MockLLM) -> parse_llm_bundle or fallback_bundle -> LlmAuditBundle; rubric_overall/blended_score on bundles
verify.route: API only (no endpoints in this slice)
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests. Tests import services.llm as a module and assign its llm to MockLLM(model_name="mockllm", config={"outputs": [...]}) from jaclang.byllm.lib before calling safe_retention_bundle; each output string is consumed by one evaluate_retention_recommendations call.

assumption: Backend slice of the JacHacks Spring project Flair (krishs09-123/jachacks-engagement-auditor): models, the by-llm retention evaluator and the audit parsing/fallback/rubric logic. Crawler, heuristics, graph-persisting audit endpoints and the UI are out of scope.
